description: Read a CSV file of up to 50 mailboxes and say what each row would do: connect, skip (the address is on an earlier row, or already connected here) or fail, and why. Nothing is saved and no login is tried. Row 1 names the columns, in English, Portuguese or Spanish: the email and a password at least, then the SMTP and IMAP servers (a Gmail address needs none). A row whose Type column says Send only is a send-only mailbox, as connect_send_only_mailbox makes one: SMTP alone, with the username its sending service gives you. It needs setup permission. A signed-in owner has it and can give it to an API key for the whole workspace. That key loses it if its maker stops being the owner.

content.description: The file's bytes, in base64, up to 256 KB. We read its encoding (UTF-8, UTF-16 or Windows-1252) and its separator (comma, semicolon or tab) from the bytes. Row 1 is the header; up to 50 mailboxes follow.

fileName.description: The file's name, like mailboxes.csv. It's shown back to you.

name: preview_mailbox_batch
title: Preview a file of mailboxes
